## Change scope

**Generation / domain:** I0 archive (read-only) / I1 / I2 proposal / shared infrastructure / documentation

**Problem and smallest correction:** Explain the present defect, its affected source paths and the expected impact. Link an issue, EXP or ADR when applicable.

**Baseline and dependencies:** Exact base SHA, open predecessor PRs and any required sequencing.

## Change type

- [ ] Documentation / navigation / maintenance only
- [ ] Behavior-preserving bug fix, test or tooling change
- [ ] Cognitive, physical or persistent behavior change (evidence / protocol linked)
- [ ] Architectural generation contract or scientific gate change (ADR / review linked)
- [ ] Synthetic research fixture only, not a living engine

## Validation and evidence

State **exact commands and full commit SHA**, result `PASS`, `FAIL` or `NOT_RUN` with reason. Distinguish static doc checks, software tests, observed behavior and prospective scientific evidence; never cite an earlier green SHA as the current one.

**Expected invariants:** first-person provenance, UC charges, admission, mortality, M11 custody, independent engine Lab and runtime, and untouched I0 archive as applicable.

**Scientific status:** `NOT_EVALUATED` / `NOT_OBSERVED` / qualified experimental verdict. Never infer L3 or I2 promotion from a successful CI run.

## Final review

- [ ] No secrets, private lives, independent held-out inputs, restricted datasets or hidden oracles leaked
- [ ] No old-runtime fallback, cross-generation living state or silent schema migration
- [ ] Appropriate source-owning docs, agent entrypoints and test pointers updated
- [ ] No unnecessary full CI or population experiment launched for a documentation-only patch
- [ ] Current branch HEAD, relevant checks and unclosed risks recorded
- [ ] Repository governance, licensing and authorized maintainer review respected
